verdict.rationale: Asaas documents an API to list and retrieve payments and check their status, plus webhooks for payment events, so an agent can monitor payment state. Card payments can be processed after creation, which supports retries, and the product sends its own automatic notifications before and after the due date over WhatsApp, email, SMS or voice bot, with interest, fines and Serasa negativação for overdue charges. However, nothing shows failed or overdue webhook event types, an API-driven retry mechanism, or API control over dunning notifications, so the agent-driven loop is only implied. Missing for 10: documented failed/overdue payment webhook events, an explicit retry API or smart-retry logic, API configuration and triggering of dunning notifications, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
